role: open-source EDR: Sysmon/ETW detection (gene rules), artifact collection, response

requirements.sysmon: required — WHIDS depends on Sysmon for kernel telemetry (ProcessCreate/ProcessTerminate logging mandatory)

notes: Installed by Plasma from the release bundle (AGPL-3.0, LICENSE travels with it). Plasma pulls alerts from Logs\Alerts and pushes IOC gene rules into Database\Rules\plasma-iocs.gen. WHIDS owns response actions; Plasma stays advisory.
